Function FieldRanges() As String
Dim p As PivotTable,f As PivotField
Set p=Worksheets(1).PivotTables(1)
On Error Resume Next
Err.Clear
FieldRanges="page=" & p.PageRange.Address
FieldRanges=FieldRanges & ":err" & CStr(Err.Number)
For Each f In p.PivotFields
FieldRanges=FieldRanges & "|" & f.Name & ":"
Err.Clear
FieldRanges=FieldRanges & f.LabelRange.Address
FieldRanges=FieldRanges & ":err" & CStr(Err.Number) & "/"
Err.Clear
FieldRanges=FieldRanges & f.DataRange.Address
FieldRanges=FieldRanges & ":err" & CStr(Err.Number)
Next
For Each f In p.DataFields
FieldRanges=FieldRanges & "|data=" & f.Name & ":"
Err.Clear
FieldRanges=FieldRanges & f.LabelRange.Address
FieldRanges=FieldRanges & ":err" & CStr(Err.Number) & "/"
Err.Clear
FieldRanges=FieldRanges & f.DataRange.Address
FieldRanges=FieldRanges & ":err" & CStr(Err.Number)
Next
End Function
